query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_causations,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN mechanismEn IS NULL OR mechanismEn = '' THEN 1 END) as missing_mechanism_en,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN mechanismAr IS NULL OR mechanismAr = '' THEN 1 END) as missing_mechanism_ar,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN evidence IS NULL OR evidence = '[]' OR evidence = '' THEN 1 END) as missing_evidence,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN strength IS NULL OR strength = 0 THEN 1 END) as missing_strength,
  AVG(strength) as avg_strength,
  AVG(confidence) as avg_confidence
FROM causations;
